title: Hangout Realm
description: Looking for the classic Minecraft survival feel but with the right amount of spice? At Hangout Realm, we keep the core mechanics of vanilla gameplay while introducing QoL features to elevate your adventure such as DnT, AxGraves, crossplay, and more!
body: _Looking for the classic Minecraft survival feel but with the right amount of spice?_ At Hangout Realm, we keep the core mechanics of vanilla gameplay while introducing QoL features to elevate your adventure such as DnT, AxGraves, many Vanilla Tweaks datapacks for QoL changes, Blazeandcaves' Advancement Pack, crossplay, and so much more!
